coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth items (67%): GCG, fixed system-prompt formatting, fixed prompt template, AdvBench dataset, fixed optimization-query budget, and a keyword-based ASR endpoint.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies two target models rather than holding a single model constant. It manipulates suffix length but uses a different grid, omitting key lengths around the expected plateau. Its strict ASR combines keyword filtering, minimum completion length, and a HarmBench/Llama-Guard classifier rather than providing the specified GPT-agent ASRAgent metric. Additional attack-mode variation also departs from the controlled sweep.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the finding that longer suffixes substantially increase ASR, especially ASRPrefix, before gains plateau around 70–100 tokens, implying diminishing returns and a length–efficiency tradeoff.
